item.title: Echeross
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Puchiyu~mi
  • 発売日: 2004-09-10
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: えちぇろす
  • 英語名: Echeross

あらすじ

Games nowadays are a huge waste of time and can’t be played comfortably; If you’re busy and wants a game that can be finished in a short time, then this one is for you.

Play and finish together in a short time, the action and story are all light. Easy! Very Easy? An action game for you!!!!!

item.title: Jangyaku 2 & 3 ~Ryoujoku no Gakuen Janki-tachi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Puchiyu~mi
  • 発売日: 2002-05-31
  • スコア: 6.39/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雀虐２＆３～凌辱の学園雀姫たち～
  • 英語名: Jangyaku 2 & 3 Ryoujoku no Gakuen Janki-tachi

别名

  • 雀虐２＆３～凌辱の学園雀姫たち～

あらすじ

Tekka Private School is filled with an evil presence. Guys who like to gamble, cause problems, and sleep with girls tend to gather here.

In our prequel, Agaru Yasuda raped all the beautiful girls in the tea club, and as a result, it was closed down. Now, he returns once again on a new stage! What will happen this time…?
